name: gs1-yonge-under
js: (() => { const app = window.__CITY_APP, C = window.CITY; const l = C.RAIL_LIFTS.reduce((b, q) => Math.hypot((q.x0 + q.x1) / 2 - 333, (q.z0 + q.z1) / 2 - 80) < Math.hypot((b.x0 + b.x1) / 2 - 333, (b.z0 + b.z1) / 2 - 80) ? q : b); const L = Math.hypot(l.x1 - l.x0, l.z1 - l.z0) || 1, ux = (l.x1 - l.x0) / L * -1, uz = (l.z1 - l.z0) / L * -1, cx = (l.x0 + l.x1) / 2, cz = (l.z0 + l.z1) / 2; const px = cx - ux * (L / 2 + 25) - uz * 4, pz = cz - uz * (L / 2 + 25) + ux * 4, y = C.deckHeightAt(px, pz, 0, 3) + 1.6; console.log('[shot] lift at ' + Math.round(cx) + ', ' + Math.round(cz) + ' deck ' + l.H + ' m'); app.teleportTo(px + 30, pz, 0); app.cameraSystem.cinema = () => ({ pos: [px, y, pz], look: [cx + ux * 20, y + 1.9, cz + uz * 20], fov: 60 }); })()

name: gs9-train-over-king
js: (() => { const app = window.__CITY_APP, C = window.CITY, R = app.railCorridor; let best = null, bd = 1e9; for (const t of R.trains) { const r = t.route; for (let i = 0; i < r.pts.length; i++) { const d = Math.hypot(r.pts[i].x - -3160, r.pts[i].z - -385); if (d < bd) { bd = d; best = { t, s: r.cum[i] }; } } } const t = best.t; t.wait = 0; t.dwell = 0; t.stopped = true; t.s = Math.min(t.route.len, best.s + 110); t.speed = 0.4; console.log('[shot] train ' + Math.round(bd) + ' m from the street, track at ' + C.railLiftAt(-3160, -385).toFixed(1) + ' m'); app.teleportTo(-3095, -300, 0); app.cameraSystem.cinema = () => ({ pos: [-3125, 1.6, -300], look: [-3160, C.railLiftAt(-3160, -385) + 2, -385], fov: 58 }); })()
